scaleBeatText: 📯 Emberhold's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
refuseBeatText: 📯 Emberhold's court summons Haven's speaker. SWEAR the oath of the realm (a gift seals it), SERVE at their court (seven days of your speaker's life), or WALK — break the link and stay a free fire, refusing the scale itself with it (the offer does not return). Or REFUSE the scale itself — stay a free fire at regional, whatever that costs. The System will not offer twice.
◈ SYSTEM: "Noted. The offer is withdrawn — permanently. No court. No oath. No tithe. The audience is... divided. Half of them just subscribed."

🚶 Haven refuses the scale. Every kcal stays in Haven's pantry — no one's court, no one's oath, no pool shares, no tariffs. The price, said plainly: no polity logistics (tribute comes in whole, never ×1.25), no league to call when the late waves come, and the table stays distant. Coalition or death — Haven walks it alone.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
